newsitem.title: USA: Schlumberger unit to develop computer program.
newsitem.headline: Schlumberger unit to develop computer program.

text.p: GeoQuest, a unit of Schlumberger Ltd, said on Friday it has assumed responsibility for ongoing development, marketing and distribution of QLA 2, a personal computer-based petrophysical interpretation program.
QLA 2 offers a system comprehensive well log analysis based on the dual-water model to help oil and natural gas companies get the most value from reserves, GeoQuest said.
GeoQuest currently is working on enhancements to QLA 2, including the transition to a Microsoft Windows 32-bit environment, as well as open database connectivity.
